perf.summary: Per-element float division by step in the hottest loop; step is loop-invariant and could be a precomputed reciprocal multiply.
perf.currentCost: '(position + halfSize) / step' executes a 3-lane float divide per entity inside QuantizeJob.Execute. Division has ~3-6x the latency/throughput cost of multiplication on PC and especially on mobile ARM NEON.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist 'float invStep = 1f / this.QuantizeStep;' out of the loop (or store an invQuantizeStep field computed once in the ctor) and change Quantized to multiply: 'new int3(math.floor((position + halfSize) * invStep))'. Keep a step-based overload for SpatialMapReadOnly3 if exact reciprocal differs.
perf.rationale: Replaces N vector divides with one reciprocal plus N vector multiplies. Multiply is significantly cheaper and pipelines better; the divisor is constant across the whole job.
perf.risk: 1/step then multiply is not always bit-identical to direct divide; math.floor could land on a different integer cell for values exactly on a quantization boundary. If exact-divide semantics must be preserved, restrict this to the Build/QuantizeJob path where cell assignment tolerance is acceptable, or document the boundary tolerance. Reject if bit-exact cell parity with the readonly query path is required.
